parallactic_angle.description: Parallactic angle rotation - geometric polarization effect

validation.description: Parallactic angle should be perfectly recovered (computed from geometry)

metadata.description: Test configuration for parallactic angle (P) effect validation
notes: Parallactic angle is a geometric effect, not calibrated like other effects
It's computed from source position and telescope location
Time-dependent: varies as source moves across sky
CASA applies this with parang=True in imaging
